title: Cerebus #111 June 1988 Aardvark-Vanaheim Comics Dave Sim ISSN 0712-7774
descriptionText: The product is a vintage comic book titled Cerebus #111 June 1988, part of the Cerebus the Aardvark series by Dave Sim and Gerhard. Published by Aardvark-Vanaheim, this softcover comic features stories like "Church & State" and "More Fun At Preney" in English language. With a mix of adventure, humor, animal characters, fantasy, and satire, this comic book from the Copper Age (1984-1991) is a collector's item for fans of comics and graphic novels. It is a single unit that comes boarded and with a dust jacket.
